name: Sports streaming subscription
definition: plan streaming live and on-demand sport from one or many leagues as its main offer (a general film-and-series service is I3.1.3.01).

name: Game server hosting plan
definition: plan renting a game-server panel (Minecraft and similar) for the user to host a game for friends or a community.

name: Beauty and skincare box
definition: recurring box of beauty, makeup or skincare products picked by the provider.

name: Snack box
definition: recurring box of snacks or sweets picked by the provider, often from other countries.
